items.name: Reflection AI Beam
items.summary: Reflection AI unveiled Beam on October 5 — a 501B-parameter (23B active) text-only MoE open-weight model trained on 23.8T tokens with a 1M-token context. Reflection claims GLM-5.2-level reasoning at 3–4x less inference compute, positioning it as the first credible Western open-weight rival to DeepSeek/Qwen; weights land later this month under Apache 2.0.

items.name: Cloudflare Clef & Clef-flash
items.summary: Cloudflare's Workers AI team shipped its first in-house trained models on October 1: two open-weight (Apache 2.0) decision models that return typed probabilities instead of text. Clef (27B, on Qwen3.8-27B) and Clef-flash (9B) are Jev-API compatible, take image/video input, and post median latencies of 209ms/39ms for agent decision loops, alongside a new RL fine-tuning service.

items.name: Google Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon on September 30, its new frontier model for long-horizon coding, enterprise knowledge work, and defensive cybersecurity, with an industry-leading 1M-token output limit and top scores on DeepSWE v1.1 (77.9%) and AutomationBench (51.3%). Rollout is phased — trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program first, then paid API and AI Ultra customers at $2/$10 per M tokens.

items.name: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: Announced at DevDay on September 29, GPT-6.1 Sol upgrades GPT-6 Sol to near-Astra capability on agentic coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra's token prices ($2 input / $10 output / $0.10 cached input per M). It replaces the paused GPT-6.1 Astra as OpenAI's workhorse tier, live via API and in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

items.name: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.summary: Released September 28, Sonnet 5.5 is the second model in the Claude 5.5 family: 30%+ faster output than Sonnet 5, up to 30% lower cost per task at unchanged pricing ($2/$10 per M tokens), and 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 — ahead of Opus 5.5's 66.4%. It's the first Sonnet with Opus-grade cyber safeguards and distillation defenses, running at effort levels Low→Max.
